
Torrey's New Topical Textbook
Author(s):
Torrey, R.A.
Publisher:
Grand Rapids, MI: Christian Classics Ethereal Library
Description:
Torrey's topical concordance happened to be published
during the same year (1897) as Orvile Nave's Topical Bible.
Although Nave's Topical Bible has remained more popular,
many still prefer Torrey's concordance, particularly those
within the Reformed and Baptist traditions. This topical con-
cordance contains 628 entries and over 20,000 scripture
references. The entries are arranged alphabetically by topic
title.
Kathleen O'Bannon
CCEL Staff
Subjects:
The Bible
Works about the Bible
